messages:
Lina: live from the all-hands backchannel — immediate standing ovation from my desk :clap: :clap:
Sam: who sneaked a vuvuzela into the build? i'm hearing phantom horn energy :vuvuzela: :joy:
Jules: not me, but kazoo 2.0 is on standby :kazoo: (patent pending)
Priya: shoutout to the snacks folks, those mini donuts were chef's kiss :donut: :heart_eyes:
Kai: low-effort democracy: pastries vs bagels. react and i'll tally. winner gets the last box.
Marta: pastries :raised_hands:
Theo: bagels forever :bagel: (expert shmear opinions incoming)
Nora: pastries for victory, bagels for commitment. this is a real strategic crossroad.
Lina: @ops-bot tally please :eyes:
ops-bot: poll results: pastries 4, bagels 3 — pastries win :tada:
Sam: confetti GIF inbound: https://giphy.com/gifs/confetti-party-12345 (10/10 would confetti again)
Jules: karaoke afterparty? i'll break out the ukulele if enough people volunteer :microphone:
Priya: i'll duet but only for a recognizable song :laughing:
Kai: anything but that one offsite song from 2019. my ears are still on leave.
Marta: meetup in 10 at the 3rd floor kitchen for donuts. first come, first glaze.
Theo: i'll judge glaze quality solemnly. this is binding.
Nora: tiny poll: next all-hands intro sound — (A) vuvuzela, (B) bacon sizzle, (C) whale call
Lina: A for chaos, C for drama, B for immediate hunger.
Sam: whale call, dramatic and slightly ominous :whale:
Jules: massive kudos to demo team, that robot bounce made me snort-laugh :clap::clap:
Priya: agree. can we make that animation the screensaver?
Kai: unofficial agenda: emoji tier list. starting a doc.
Marta: coffee run — reply if you want something and i'll judge your caffeine choices on sight :coffee:
Theo: double espresso, judge wisely.
Nora: oat latte pls xoxo
Lina: someone gif-raid the CEO with puppy pics pls :puppy: :pray:
Sam: pulling up puppies_final_2025 now:
/puppies_final_2025/  - otis_sleeping.jpg  - panda_outfit.gif  - loaf_bark.mp4
Jules: morale secured. :sparkles:
